Employee Policy Handbook
Northwind Software Private Limited
Version 4.1, effective from 1 April 2026
About this handbook
This handbook explains the main policies that apply to all employees of Northwind Software
Private Limited in India. It covers leave, attendance, working hours, remote work, conduct, IT
security, travel, performance reviews and leaving the company.
If a policy in this handbook is different from your employment contract, the contract applies.
Questions about any policy can be sent to the People team at people@northwind.example.
Who this handbook applies to
The handbook applies to all full-time and part-time employees. Interns and contractors follow
the rules on conduct and IT security, but not the rules on leave and benefits, unless their
contract says otherwise.
Changes to policies
The People team reviews the handbook every year in March. Employees are told about any
change by email at least 30 days before it takes effect.
